entries.evidence: The two cranes are mirror images, and both place one actuator submodel (42078 - craneactu.ldr), unmirrored. Its axle 9 runs from the actuator's bevel gear to the crane's back, where a connector holds each end and a red axle 6 plugs the crane onto the trailer's shaft (steps 142 and 143, page 336, https://www.lego.com/cdn/product-assets/product.bi.core.pdf/6230125.pdf#page=336; step 154, page 341, #page=341; step 155, page 342, #page=342). In the front crane the axle 9 (p2196) has its connectors p2206 and p2320 over its two ends, 20 LDU of it in each. In the rear crane the same axle (p1968) lies 40 LDU too far back: it stops 20 LDU short of the connector p2108 that should hold it, and runs into the second half of the connector p1986, where the red axle p2078 is. So the front crane's drive stops at the rear crane, and its actuator isn't driven (function 9). Moved 40 LDU along itself toward the trailer, in the rear crane only, it fills both connectors' halves as in the front crane.
